name: Maize's Mission
source:
In Maize's Mission you play as Maize on her first day in a new town. Unfortunately, her mischievous younger siblings have gotten into a bit of trouble and it is up to her to fix things... as usual!

[From [url=https://carnalmantrap.itch.io/maizes-mission]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《玉米的使命》中，你扮演玉米，在新城镇的第一天。不幸的是，她淘气的弟弟妹妹遇到了一些麻烦，需要她来解决问题……像往常一样！

[来自[url=https://carnalmantrap.itch.io/maizes-mission]itch.io[/url]]
